verdict.rationale: Vercel Sandbox is explicitly designed to run untrusted/agent-generated code in isolated Linux microVMs without exposing production systems, with multi-agent isolation, persistent state, and safe test previews (logs, file edits, live previews) — directly matching the story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs, and no explicit case study showing a real production-data separation guarantee being tested/audited.
